#include<bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int maxn = 5005;
typedef int T;
const T INF = 1e9+7;
const int K = 100;

struct Edge {
    int  u , v ;
    T cap ,flow , cost;
};

struct MCMF {
    int n,m,s,t;      // Total Number of Node Including S,T
    list<int> G[maxn];     //Graph
    vector<Edge> E;         // EdgeList
    T d[maxn];             // Distance Array of BeTmanFord
    bool inq[maxn];           // Is node in queue
    int p[maxn];
    T a[maxn];

    MCMF(int n) : n(n) {}

    void addEdge( int u , int v , T cap , T cost ){
//        cout<<u<<" "<<v<<" "<<cap<<"/"<<cost<<endl;
        E.push_back({u, v , cap , 0 , cost});       // Positive Cost
        E.push_back({v,u , 0, 0 , -cost } );        // Negative Cost
        m = (int) E.size();
        G[u].push_back(m - 2);
        G[v].push_back(m - 1);
    }

    bool BelmanFord(T &flow , T &cost ) {
        for(int i = 0; i < n ;i  ++) d[i] = INF ;
        memset(inq, 0, sizeof(inq));
        d[s] = 0; inq[s] = 1; p[s] = 0; a[s] = INF;

        queue<int> Q;
        Q.push(s);
        while(!Q.empty() ) {
            int u = Q.front(); Q.pop();
            inq[u] = 0;

            for( int i = 0 ; i < G[u].size() ; i ++ ) {
                Edge &e = E[G[u][i]];
                if( e.cap > e.flow && d[e.v] > d[u] + e.cost ) {
                    d[e.v] = d[u] + e.cost;
                    p[e.v] = G[u][i];
                    a[e.v] = min( a[u] , e.cap - e.flow );

                    if( inq[e.v ] == 0 ) {
                        Q.push(e.v);
                        inq[e.v] = 1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if( d[t] == INF ) return false;     // No augmenting Path
        flow = a[t];
        cost = d[t] ;               // Unit cost
        int u = t ;
        while( u  != s ) {
            E[p[u]].flow += a[t];
            E[p[u]^1].flow -= a[t];
            u = E[p[u]].u;
        }
        return true;
    }

    pair<T,T> Mincost (int s, int t) {
        this->s=s,this->t=t;
        T Mcost = 0;
        T Flow = 0;
        T f = 0 ;    // For Each CaT , The flow
        T d = 0;      // Shortest Distance / Cost Per Flow

        while(BelmanFord(f,d)) {
            Flow += f;
            Mcost += f *d ;
        }
        return make_pair(Flow, Mcost);
    }
};

int main() {
    int n, m, k, C, D;
    cin>>n>>m>>k>>C>>D;

    MCMF solver(n*K+2);
    int source = n*K, sink = n*K+1;

    for (int i=0; i<K; i++)
        solver.addEdge(i, sink, k, C*i);


    for (int i=0; i<k; i++) {
        int x;
        cin>>x;
        x--;
        solver.addEdge(source, x*K, 1, 0);
    }

    for (int i=0; i<n; i++)
        for (int j=1; j<K; j++)
            solver.addEdge(i*K+j-1, i*K+j, k, 0);

    while (m--) {
        int u, v;
        cin>>u>>v;
        u--; v--;

        for (int j=1; j<K; j++) {
            int a = u*K+j-1, b = v*K+j;
            int c = v*K+j-1, d = u*K+j;

            for (int i=1, cc = D; i<=k; i++, cc += 2*D) {
                solver.addEdge(a, b, 1, cc);
                solver.addEdge(c, d, 1, cc);
            }
        }
    }
    auto pr = solver.Mincost(source, sink);
    cout<<pr.second<<endl;

import sys
from collections import deque
import math

class Edge:
    def __init__(self, u, v, cap, flow, cost):
        self.u = u
        self.v = v
        self.cap = cap
        self.flow = flow
        self.cost = cost

class MCMF:
    def __init__(self, n):
        self.n = n
        self.G = [[] for _ in range(n)]
        self.E = []
        self.d = [float('inf')] * n
        self.inq = [False] * n
        self.p = [0] * n
        self.a = [float('inf')] * n

    def addEdge(self, u, v, cap, cost):
        self.E.append(Edge(u, v, cap, 0, cost))
        self.E.append(Edge(v, u, 0, 0, -cost))
        self.m = len(self.E)
        self.G[u].append(self.m - 2)
        self.G[v].append(self.m - 1)

    def BelmanFord(self, flow, cost):
        for i in range(self.n):
            self.d[i] = float('inf')
        self.inq = [False] * self.n
        self.d[self.s] = 0
        self.inq[self.s] = True
        self.p[self.s] = 0
        self.a[self.s] = float('inf')

        Q = deque()
        Q.append(self.s)
        while Q:
            u = Q.popleft()
            self.inq[u] = False

            for i in range(len(self.G[u])):
                e = self.E[self.G[u][i]]
                if e.cap > e.flow and self.d[e.v] > self.d[u] + e.cost:
                    self.d[e.v] = self.d[u] + e.cost
                    self.p[e.v] = self.G[u][i]
                    self.a[e.v] = min(self.a[u], e.cap - e.flow)

                    if not self.inq[e.v]:
                        Q.append(e.v)
                        self.inq[e.v] = True
        if self.d[self.t] == float('inf'):
            return False
        flow = self.a[self.t]
        cost = self.d[self.t]
        u = self.t
        while u != self.s:
            self.E[self.p[u]].flow += flow
            self.E[self.p[u] ^ 1].flow -= flow
            u = self.E[self.p[u]].u
        return True

    def Mincost(self, s, t):
        self.s = s
        self.t = t
        flow = 0
        cost = 0
        while self.BelmanFord(flow, cost):
            flow += flow
            cost += flow * cost
        return flow, cost

def main():
    n, m, k, C, D = map(int, input().split())
    solver = MCMF(n * k + 2)
    source = n * k
    sink = n * k + 1

    for i in range(k):
        solver.addEdge(i, sink, k, C * i)

    for i in range(k):
        x = int(input()) - 1
        solver.addEdge(source, x * k, 1, 0)

    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(1, k):
            solver.addEdge(i * k + j - 1, i * k + j, k, 0)

    while m:
        u, v = map(int, input().split())
        u -= 1
        v -= 1

        for j in range(1, k):
            a = u * k + j - 1
            b = v * k + j
            c = v * k + j - 1
            d = u * k + j

            for i in range(1, k + 1):
                cc = D * 2 * i
                solver.addEdge(a, b, 1, cc)
                solver.addEdge(c, d, 1, cc)
        m -= 1

    flow, cost = solver.Mincost(source, sink)
    print(cost)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
